kurz: Egg white is almost nothing but water and protein. It can be whipped into a foam and sets in the heat.
bild_im_kopf: Like liquid building material you can foam up and then let set.
was_passiert: The proteins in egg white unfold when whisked and coat air bubbles. In the heat they set earlier than the yolk.
faustregeln: Separate without a trace of yolk.
